name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2067: vault_ledger_load had exactly ONE caller in the whole console - inside _vault_sweep_run - so the accumulated ledger, and every sighting time and frame id v2064 and v2065 put on it, could only be seen as a side effect of paying for a sweep. Looking at what the AI had already seen cost a re-read. There is now a free read and a console panel for it, rendering through the same _vaultNames the proposal uses. It distinguishes absent from unreadable from empty, which the old loader folds into one. Two defects surfaced only by running it: the handler was written in a different closure from the row renderer and threw at click time, and TEN javascript string literals used the python escape backslash-U-0001-XXXX, which JS renders as literal text - so the EAGLE EYE panel had been printing U0001F985 instead of the bird. Also conf 0 now reads confidence not recorded, because the keep floor is 0.55 and no grounded row can carry a zero.
